label: Pool reference
note: Package BAL6 (K17, owner 10-27 11:22): per map, the deck optimizer's best deck from the cards a player holds arriving there (starter + earlier maps' first-clear cards + faction rewards + 5 random pack Commons a map; docs/balance/ref/ref-pool-pools.json), at the Map reference's level (referencePlayerLevel). A per-map set ("decks", not "counts"): the tools play it; tools/opt/ref_decks.js does not bake it into the game.
